_about: Crissa's own voice for Pocket TTS on the CPU (the User 2026-10-17: 'our imagine voice must stick ... that is the TM and our brand'). A Pocket voice state: her Grok Imagine clip (crissa-imagine.wav, Created with Grok) run once through kyutai/pocket-tts's export_model_state, the same kind of file as Pocket's stock voices ('embeddings precomputed with our released weights'). The kit's Pocket model (pocket-tts without voice cloning) loads it as it loads a stock voice: no cloning on your machine, no login. Nothing in it is a recording of a person.
